text: I am writing to respectfully request the implementation of an all-way stop control at the intersection of Eastern Avenue and Rolling Mills Road. Residents have concerns about pedestrian safety on the roadways. Transportation Services has reviewed the need for an all-way stop control at the subject intersection. Based on staff's investigation, the installation of the all-way stop control is technically warranted and will enhance operational safety at this intersection.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized an all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of Eastern Avenue and Rolling Mills Road.
